subject: design/e2e-verification-artifacts-v2
statement: the class's version string bumps to **`e2e-design/v2`** rather than reusing `v1`. Template versions are compatibility contracts validated against the version a document *declares* (`design:tech-design-conventions` §3.1), and the frozen predecessor defines `e2e-design/v1` as the six-section class with a prose harness part. That definition stays readable forever; reusing the string would make one version identifier name two incompatible contracts, and any checker validating "declared v1" would have to pick which one it meant. No instance of v1 survives to migrate (`design-brainstorm:e2e-verification-tech-design-2#D-2`), so the bump costs nothing and buys an unambiguous contract.
